description:
Granadella Castle is a historic castle restored while respecting its original structure, in L'Ampolla, a short distance from the Ebro Delta. It sits close to two other historic fortifications in the area — Castell de Camarles (1.9 km) and Torre de Vinaixarop (6.2 km) — part of a small coastal defensive cluster in Catalonia.

Guest reviews consistently and specifically confirm the building's authenticity: "a charming boutique hotel steeped in history, the owner explains fascinating details about the castle's history from its origins" and "the restoration has been very respectful of the original structure and achieves a charming palatial atmosphere." Owners Daniel and Ana personally manage the property and offer guests guided tours through the castle's history.

Today its Double and Deluxe rooms (20-25 sqm) offer pool views.

The castle's position within a small cluster of coastal Catalan fortifications near the Ebro Delta ties Granadella to a specific regional defensive network, alongside Castle of la Zuda in nearby Tortosa, already featured in this collection.

The owners' personal, historically informed guided tours distinguish Granadella from standardized hotel-chain service, giving guests direct access to the castle's history from the people who restored it.

The castle's position near the Ebro Delta gives guests staying at Granadella access to one of Catalonia's most significant wetland and birdwatching areas.
